prompt:
EDIT this Gumiho image. Preserve fox body, four paws, single fox head, village school and light. There are currently EIGHT visible tails. Add exactly ONE additional large furry tail extending LOW TO VIEWER-RIGHT from the rump, below the existing rightmost horizontal tail, with its own separated tip around right edge midheight. Total EXACTLY NINE tails and NINE distinct tips, all attach naturally to one rump. Do not remove or merge any existing tail. Do not add a tenth. Keep threatening prowl. No text/aura. Original specification: ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of Gumiho, uncanny Korean nine-tailed fox spirit.

Nine tails attach to one rump, fanning separately behind body in a clear arc; one tail at far left, then seven evenly separated tails, one at far right. NO extra tail tips, human face, wings, horns or multiple heads. White-grey fox coat editorial, sharp natural fox muzzle and ears.
MOMENT: Crouch at midnight village-school threshold and prowl toward viewer with one forepaw reaching across sill, head lowered in cunning focused gaze. Fan all NINE tails behind like a physical mass of fur, distinct tips not crossing, no floating jewel needed.
POWER: Uncanny sorcerous fox tradition [gumiho-c11], fox visits school at midnight in transformation tale [gumiho-c10]. Choose fox before human guise; no visible magic invented.
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low angle; low close three-quarter body, 9tailfan fills upper background, head/paws foreground; normal fox size beside wooden threshold.
LIGHT & WEATHER: one dominant low amber moon or lamp, deep walnut shadows, strong rim light, ordinary water spray or dust as appropriate.
SURFACE: tactile wet skin, coarse cloth, scales, hair, old wood and stone; premium painterly brushwork.
SETTING: Korean village school at midnight [gumiho-c10].
MOOD: imposing and active, never cute, calm or decorative. Sacred and benevolent figures remain dignified and protective.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, pseudoletters, inscriptions, logo, border, frame or watermark; no extra heads, eyes, limbs or fingers; no film, game, anime or comic designs; fully opaque clothing on humanoids; no nudity, blood or explicit gore; no generic glow aura, neon outline, floating runes or energy ribbons.
